notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
description:
Pay {R}{R} activate Pyrohemia twice, Creating 3 token copies of Polyraptor.
Sacrifice a Polyraptor to Altar, adding {R}.
Activate Pyrohemia, creating a token for each Polyraptor you control.
Repeat sacrificing the oldest Polyraptor to Phyrexian Altar.
